def IsLipMatrix {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (L : ChannelMatrix I) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ dom ϕ, ∀ y ∈ dom ϕ, ∀ j : I,
    d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ ∑ i : I, L i j * d i x y

def IsLipOn {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (L : ChannelMatrix I) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
    d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ ∑ i : I, L i j * d i x y

def IsRestrictedLipMatrix {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (L : ChannelMatrix I) : Prop :=
  U ⊆ dom ϕ ∧
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ ∑ i : I, L i j * d i x y

theorem isRestrictedLipMatrix_iff_isLipOn {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) {U : Set X}
    (hU : U ⊆ dom ϕ) (L : ChannelMatrix I) :
    IsRestrictedLipMatrix d ϕ U L ↔ IsLipOn d ϕ U L :=
  ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hU, h⟩⟩

theorem isRestrictedLipMatrix_dom_iff {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (L : ChannelMatrix I) :
    IsRestrictedLipMatrix d ϕ (dom ϕ) L ↔ IsLipMatrix d ϕ L := by
  constructor
  · exact fun h => h.2
  · exact fun h => ⟨Set.Subset.rfl, h⟩

theorem restrictedLipCertFamily_dom_eq {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) :
    RestrictedLipCertFamily d ϕ (dom ϕ) = LipCertFamily d ϕ := by
  ext L
  exact isRestrictedLipMatrix_dom_iff d ϕ L

theorem restrictedLipCertFamily_mono {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) {U V : Set X}
    (hUV : U ⊆ V) (hV : V ⊆ dom ϕ) :
    RestrictedLipCertFamily d ϕ V ⊆ RestrictedLipCertFamily d ϕ U := by
  intro L hL
  refine ⟨Set.Subset.trans hUV hV, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy j
  exact hL.2 x (hUV hx) y (hUV hy) j

theorem lipCertFamily_subset_restrictedLipCertFamily {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) {U : Set X}
    (hU : U ⊆ dom ϕ) :
    LipCertFamily d ϕ ⊆ RestrictedLipCertFamily d ϕ U := by
  rw [← restrictedLipCertFamily_dom_eq d ϕ]
  exact restrictedLipCertFamily_mono d ϕ hU Set.Subset.rfl

theorem restrictedLipCertFamily_comp {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ₂ ϕ₁ : Operator X bot) (U₁ : Set X)
    (L₂ L₁ : ChannelMatrix I)
    (hU₁ : U₁ ⊆ dom (operator_compose ϕ₂ ϕ₁))
    (hL₁ : L₁ ∈ RestrictedLipCertFamily d ϕ₁ U₁)
    (hL₂ : L₂ ∈ RestrictedLipCertFamily d ϕ₂ (operator_image ϕ₁ U₁)) :
    channelMatrixMul L₂ L₁ ∈ RestrictedLipCertFamily d (operator_compose ϕ₂ ϕ₁) U₁ := by
  refine ⟨hU₁, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy j
  have hx₂ : ϕ₁.func x ∈ operator_image ϕ₁ U₁ := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hy₂ : ϕ₁.func y ∈ operator_image ϕ₁ U₁ := ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  have h_step₂ := hL₂.2 (ϕ₁.func x) hx₂ (ϕ₁.func y) hy₂ j
  have h_step₁ :
      ∑ k : I, L₂ k j * d k (ϕ₁.func x) (ϕ₁.func y) ≤
        ∑ k : I, L₂ k j * (∑ i : I, L₁ i k * d i x y) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro k _
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hL₁.2 x hx y hy k) (zero_le _)
  have h_rearrange :
      (∑ k : I, L₂ k j * (∑ i : I, L₁ i k * d i x y)) =
        ∑ i : I, channelMatrixMul L₂ L₁ i j * d i x y := by
    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← mul_assoc]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    congr 1 with i
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    rfl
  exact le_trans h_step₂ (h_rearrange ▸ h_step₁)

def IsRestrictedCoLipMatrix {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (K : ChannelMatrix I) : Prop :=
  U.Nonempty ∧ U ⊆ dom ϕ ∧
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : I,
      ∑ i : I, K i j * d i x y ≤ d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y)

theorem nonempty_of_mem_restrictedCoLipCertFamily {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    {d : I → X → X → ENNReal} {ϕ : Operator X bot} {U : Set X} {K : ChannelMatrix I}
    (hK : K ∈ RestrictedCoLipCertFamily d ϕ U) :
    U.Nonempty ∧ U ⊆ dom ϕ :=
  ⟨hK.1, hK.2.1⟩

@[simp] theorem restrictedCoLipCertFamily_empty {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) :
    RestrictedCoLipCertFamily d ϕ ∅ = ∅ := by
  ext K
  simp [RestrictedCoLipCertFamily, IsRestrictedCoLipMatrix]

theorem restrictedCoLipCertFamily_mono {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) {U V : Set X}
    (hU_ne : U.Nonempty) (hUV : U ⊆ V) (hV : V ⊆ dom ϕ) :
    RestrictedCoLipCertFamily d ϕ V ⊆ RestrictedCoLipCertFamily d ϕ U := by
  intro K hK
  refine ⟨hU_ne, Set.Subset.trans hUV hV, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy j
  exact hK.2.2 x (hUV hx) y (hUV hy) j

theorem restrictedCoLipCertFamily_dom_subset {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) {U : Set X}
    (hU_ne : U.Nonempty) (hU : U ⊆ dom ϕ) :
    RestrictedCoLipCertFamily d ϕ (dom ϕ) ⊆ RestrictedCoLipCertFamily d ϕ U :=
  restrictedCoLipCertFamily_mono d ϕ hU_ne hU Set.Subset.rfl

theorem restrictedCoLipCertFamily_comp {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ₂ ϕ₁ : Operator X bot) (U₁ : Set X)
    (K₂ K₁ : ChannelMatrix I)
    (hU₁ : U₁ ⊆ dom (operator_compose ϕ₂ ϕ₁))
    (hK₁ : K₁ ∈ RestrictedCoLipCertFamily d ϕ₁ U₁)
    (hK₂ : K₂ ∈ RestrictedCoLipCertFamily d ϕ₂ (operator_image ϕ₁ U₁)) :
    channelMatrixMul K₂ K₁ ∈ RestrictedCoLipCertFamily d (operator_compose ϕ₂ ϕ₁) U₁ := by
  refine ⟨hK₁.1, hU₁, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy j
  have hx₂ : ϕ₁.func x ∈ operator_image ϕ₁ U₁ := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hy₂ : ϕ₁.func y ∈ operator_image ϕ₁ U₁ := ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  have h_step₂ := hK₂.2.2 (ϕ₁.func x) hx₂ (ϕ₁.func y) hy₂ j
  have h_step₁ :
      ∑ k : I, K₂ k j * (∑ i : I, K₁ i k * d i x y) ≤
        ∑ k : I, K₂ k j * d k (ϕ₁.func x) (ϕ₁.func y) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro k _
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hK₁.2.2 x hx y hy k) (zero_le _)
  have h_rearrange :
      (∑ i : I, channelMatrixMul K₂ K₁ i j * d i x y) =
        ∑ k : I, K₂ k j * (∑ i : I, K₁ i k * d i x y) := by
    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← mul_assoc]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    congr 1 with i
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    rfl
  exact le_trans (h_rearrange.trans_le h_step₁) h_step₂

evidence.quote: abbrev ChannelMatrix (I : Type) : Type := I → I → ENNReal

def channelEntry {I : Type} (M : ChannelMatrix I) (i j : I) : ENNReal :=
  M i j

def rowColEntry {I : Type} (M : ChannelMatrix I) (j i : I) : ENNReal :=
  M i j

def toRowColMatrix {I : Type} (M : ChannelMatrix I) : Matrix I I ENNReal :=
  Matrix.of (fun j i => M i j)

def ofRowColMatrix {I : Type} (A : Matrix I I ENNReal) : ChannelMatrix I :=
  fun i j => A j i

@[simp] theorem rowColEntry_eq_channelEntry {I : Type} (M : ChannelMatrix I) (i j : I) :
    rowColEntry M j i = channelEntry M i j :=
  rfl

@[simp] theorem toRowColMatrix_apply {I : Type} (M : ChannelMatrix I) (j i : I) :
    toRowColMatrix M j i = M i j :=
  rfl

@[simp] theorem ofRowColMatrix_apply {I : Type} (A : Matrix I I ENNReal) (i j : I) :
    ofRowColMatrix A i j = A j i :=
  rfl

@[simp] theorem ofRowColMatrix_toRowColMatrix {I : Type} (M : ChannelMatrix I) :
    ofRowColMatrix (toRowColMatrix M) = M :=
  rfl

@[simp] theorem toRowColMatrix_ofRowColMatrix {I : Type} (A : Matrix I I ENNReal) :
    toRowColMatrix (ofRowColMatrix A) = A :=
  rfl

noncomputable def channelMatrixMul {I : Type} [Fintype I] (M₂ M₁ : ChannelMatrix I) : ChannelMatrix I :=
  fun i j => ∑ k : I, M₂ k j * M₁ i k

@[simp] theorem channelMatrixMul_apply {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (M₂ M₁ : ChannelMatrix I) (i j : I) :
    channelMatrixMul M₂ M₁ i j = ∑ k : I, M₂ k j * M₁ i k :=
  rfl

noncomputable def channelMatrixId {I : Type} [DecidableEq I] : ChannelMatrix I :=
  fun i j => if i = j then 1 else 0

theorem toRowColMatrix_channelMatrixMul {I : Type} [Fintype I] (M₂ M₁ : ChannelMatrix I) :
    toRowColMatrix (channelMatrixMul M₂ M₁) = toRowColMatrix M₂ * toRowColMatrix M₁ := by
  ext j i
  simp [toRowColMatrix, channelMatrixMul, Matrix.mul_apply]

theorem channelMatrixMul_assoc {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (M₃ M₂ M₁ : ChannelMatrix I) :
    channelMatrixMul (channelMatrixMul M₃ M₂) M₁ =
      channelMatrixMul M₃ (channelMatrixMul M₂ M₁) := by
  have h := Matrix.mul_assoc (toRowColMatrix M₃) (toRowColMatrix M₂) (toRowColMatrix M₁)
  simp only [← toRowColMatrix_channelMatrixMul] at h
  exact congrArg ofRowColMatrix h

evidence.quote: abbrev ComponentChannel (I : Type) : Type := I × I

def ComponentChannel.inputIdx {I : Type} (c : ComponentChannel I) : I :=
  c.1

def ComponentChannel.outputIdx {I : Type} (c : ComponentChannel I) : I :=
  c.2

def sameComponentChannel {I : Type} (i : I) : ComponentChannel I :=
  (i, i)

def channelCoeff {I : Type} (M : ChannelMatrix I) (c : ComponentChannel I) : ENNReal :=
  M c.1 c.2

def IsSingleInputRow {I : Type} (M : ChannelMatrix I) (i j : I) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : I, k ≠ i → M k j = 0

def IsDiagonalInputRow {I : Type} (M : ChannelMatrix I) (j : I) : Prop :=
  IsSingleInputRow M j j

def IsDiagonalChannelMatrix {I : Type} (M : ChannelMatrix I) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : I, i ≠ j → M i j = 0

theorem isDiagonalChannelMatrix_iff_forall_isSingleInputRow {I : Type} (M : ChannelMatrix I) :
    IsDiagonalChannelMatrix M ↔ ∀ j : I, IsSingleInputRow M j j := by
  constructor
  · intro h j k hkj
    exact h k j hkj
  · intro h i j hij
    exact h j i hij

theorem isDiagonalChannelMatrix_iff_toRowColMatrix_offDiag_zero {I : Type} (M : ChannelMatrix I) :
    IsDiagonalChannelMatrix M ↔ ∀ j i : I, j ≠ i → toRowColMatrix M j i = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h j i hji
    exact h i j (Ne.symm hji)
  · intro h i j hij
    exact h j i (Ne.symm hij)

evidence.quote:
theorem singleInputRow_sum_eq {X I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (L : ChannelMatrix I) (i j : I)
    (h_row : IsSingleInputRow L i j) (x y : X) :
    (∑ k : I, L k j * d k x y) = L i j * d i x y := by
  refine Finset.sum_eq_single i ?_ ?_
  · intro k _ hki
    rw [h_row k hki, zero_mul]
  · intro hi_not_mem
    exact False.elim (hi_not_mem (Finset.mem_univ i))

theorem singleInputRow_lip_bound {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (L : ChannelMatrix I) (i j : I)
    (hL : L ∈ RestrictedLipCertFamily d ϕ U)
    (h_row : IsSingleInputRow L i j) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U,
      d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ ∑ k : I, L k j * d k x y ∧
      (∑ k : I, L k j * d k x y) = L i j * d i x y ∧
      d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ L i j * d i x y := by
  intro x hx y hy
  have h_sum : (∑ k : I, L k j * d k x y) = L i j * d i x y :=
    singleInputRow_sum_eq d L i j h_row x y
  have h_lip : d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ ∑ k : I, L k j * d k x y :=
    hL.2 x hx y hy j
  exact ⟨h_lip, h_sum, h_sum ▸ h_lip⟩

theorem singleInputRow_lip_le {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (L : ChannelMatrix I) (i j : I)
    (hL : L ∈ RestrictedLipCertFamily d ϕ U)
    (h_row : IsSingleInputRow L i j) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U,
      d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ L i j * d i x y :=
  fun x hx y hy => (singleInputRow_lip_bound d ϕ U L i j hL h_row x hx y hy).2.2

theorem diagonal_lip_bound {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (L : ChannelMatrix I)
    (hL : L ∈ RestrictedLipCertFamily d ϕ U)
    (h_diag : IsDiagonalChannelMatrix L) :
    ∀ i : I, ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U,
      (∑ k : I, L k i * d k x y) = L i i * d i x y ∧
      d i (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ L i i * d i x y := by
  intro i x hx y hy
  have h_row : IsSingleInputRow L i i :=
    (isDiagonalChannelMatrix_iff_forall_isSingleInputRow L).mp h_diag i
  have h := singleInputRow_lip_bound d ϕ U L i i hL h_row x hx y hy
  exact ⟨h.2.1, h.2.2⟩

evidence.quote:
theorem single_channel_coLip_le {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (K : ChannelMatrix I) (i j : I)
    (hK : K ∈ RestrictedCoLipCertFamily d ϕ U) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U,
      K i j * d i x y ≤ d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) := by
  intro x hx y hy
  have h_single : K i j * d i x y ≤ ∑ k : I, K k j * d k x y :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => zero_le (K k j * d k x y)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  exact le_trans h_single (hK.2.2 x hx y hy j)

theorem pos_coLip_channel_preserves_pos_dist {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (K : ChannelMatrix I) (i j : I)
    (hK : K ∈ RestrictedCoLipCertFamily d ϕ U)
    (hKij : 0 < K i j) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U,
      0 < d i x y → 0 < d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) := by
  intro x hx y hy hd
  have h_prod_pos : 0 < K i j * d i x y :=
    ENNReal.mul_pos hKij.ne' hd.ne'
  have h_le : K i j * d i x y ≤ d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) :=
    single_channel_coLip_le d ϕ U K i j hK x hx y hy
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_prod_pos h_le

theorem coLip_entry_eq_zero_of_dist_zero_of_pos {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)
    (K : ChannelMatrix I) (i j : I)
    (hK : K ∈ RestrictedCoLipCertFamily d ϕ U)
    {x y : X} (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ U)
    (h_out : d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) = 0)
    (h_in : 0 < d i x y) :
    K i j = 0 := by
  by_contra hK_ne
  have hK_pos : 0 < K i j := pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hK_ne
  have h_pos := pos_coLip_channel_preserves_pos_dist d ϕ U K i j hK hK_pos x hx y hy h_in
  exact h_pos.ne' h_out

    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X)

evidence.quote:
theorem exercise_2_2_scalar_two_sided_bound {X I : Type} {bot : X} [Fintype I]
    (d : I → X → X → ENNReal) (ϕ : Operator X bot) (U : Set X) (j : I)
    (L K : ChannelMatrix I)
    (_hU : U ⊆ dom ϕ)
    (hL : L ∈ RestrictedLipCertFamily d ϕ U)
    (hK : K ∈ RestrictedCoLipCertFamily d ϕ U)
    (hL_diag_row : IsSingleInputRow L j j) :

      K j j * d j x y ≤ d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ∧
      d j (ϕ.func x) (ϕ.func y) ≤ L j j * d j x y := by
